text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=autoscaler-hotpath (rule: queue_depth > 1500 for 5m). PD incident INC1234567 created. Priority: P1.
pagerduty-bot: INC1234567 -> routed to eng-oncall rotation. https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC1234567
maya: acked. I'm taking primary (oncall). Jumping in. :rotating_light:
eric: seeing it too. Autoscaler requested nodes but kube shows Pending with reason=ProvisioningFailed. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/auto/queue?panelId=3&from=-15m queue_depth=~1800, dispatch latency p99=3.2s.
liu: checking cloud console — spot pool in us-west-2 returned multiple "AllocationFailed: Insufficient capacity" for last 6 requests. Looks like regional spot exhaustion.
maya: can we failover to reserved pool in us-west-2 or route critical traffic to dedicated fleet in eu-west-1?
eric: we have reserved-pool in us-west-2 but autoscaler policy won't use it automatically (config gating). I'll try manual scale to reserved.
maya: running: `./bin/infra scale --pool reserved-pool --region us-west-2 --count 8`
alex: dispatcher logs show worker rejections, sample:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z WARN  dispatcher main queue_length=1789 dispatch_delay_ms=4200
2026-03-15T14:03:03Z ERROR worker_reject worker_id=wk-7 reason=no_free_slot
2026-03-15T14:03:57Z WARN  autoscaler request_id=abc123 status=rate_limited
```
maya: manual scale partially succeeded — 3 nodes provisioned, 5 failed with AllocationFailed. Initiating cross-region failover to eu-west-1 for non-enterprise routes.
priya: checking customer impact: ~1200 active requests in queue; error rate at gateway is ~0.5% (mostly 429s), top affected customers are small-mid SaaS tenants, a couple enterprise accounts seeing increased latency. Support alert created.
sara: support FYI: we’ve had 18 tickets in last 10m about slow responses; tagging enterprise CS for the two affected accounts. No full outages reported yet.
eric: autoscaler logs show backoff kicks in after repeated allocation failures, so it reduces request rate for new provisioning attempts. That explains partial success.
liu: I filed a support request with cloud provider for capacity (https://status.cloudprovider/incident/6789), but that's not an immediate fix.
maya: temporary mitigation plan: 1) route non-critical traffic to eu-west-1 2) enable reserved-pool for hotpath 3) reduce batch sizes to lower per-request resource pressure. Applying now.
alex: patching runtime config to drop kvcache prefetch and reduce batching. PUT /configs/serving-hotpath: `{"kvcache.prefetch": false, "batch.max_tokens": 256}`

maya: applied config. Observing queue depth drop from 1800 -> 980 in ~4m. p95 latency improving to ~1.3s.
priya: error rate down to 0.2%, gateway 429s reduced. Customer impact significantly lower now.
eric: good. PD: can we reassign incident and set a 30m watch window? maya: yes, I'll stay on until handing off.
maya: acknowledged in PD — INC1234567 acked by maya. @eric @liu @alex please stand by for handoff in 25m.
pagerduty-bot: INC1234567 acknowledged by maya.
triage-bot: Reminder: create incident page and link to postmortem template: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/template.
maya: creating incident page and initial notes. Root cause preliminary: regional spot capacity exhaustion combined with autoscaler aggressive backoff under high backlog. Action items added to page.
alex: captured a short snippet that helped: autoscaler was using exponential backoff without considering backlog size — when allocation failed, it reduced retries even though queue was growing. We should change policy to decouple allocation backoff from backlog signalling.
liu: operational action: request to increase reserved capacity in us-west-2 by +6 nodes and run capacity drills. Filed infra ticket INF-4321.
priya: support update posted to customers impacted; we recommended retry with backoff and offered status updates.
maya: plan to hand over to next oncall in 30m after stabilization. I'll keep PD open until queue < 200 and error rate < 0.1% for 10m.
eric: agreed. Thanks for quick mitigations.
maya: creating postmortem draft and tagging SRE/infra/product for follow-ups. Adding mitigation timeline and client outreach notes. :memo: :white_check_mark:
triage-bot: Postmortem checklist added to incident page.
maya: closing thread here, will update PD when we meet safe thresholds. Thanks all.
